extracted.name: Classic Chicken Caesar Salad
extracted.description: This chicken Caesar salad is delicious and satisfying with crunchy romaine, juicy chicken, seasoned croutons, rich Parmesan, and a creamy bottled dressing.
ingredient_lines: 6 cups tightly packed chopped romaine lettuce
1 pound cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
0.5 cup CRACKER BARREL Finely Shredded 100% Parmesan Cheese
instruction_lines: Arrange lettuce on four serving plates. Top with chicken, Parmesan, and croutons, then drizzle with dressing.
